notes:
v4.6.53 — DAY bot now trades IBKR (not Alpaca) on the IBKR cloud; LONG IBKR fixes

🐛 FIXED — DAY bot was still trading your ALPACA account on IBKR
• The DAY bot built a raw Alpaca connection directly, so even when set to IBKR it kept reading/trading your Alpaca portfolio. It now routes through the broker layer like the other bots, so on IBKR it trades its IBKR sub-portfolio slice (e.g. its 10% = $100k), with its bracket orders placed as native IBKR stop/target legs.

🐛 FIXED — LONG bot errors on IBKR
• LONG hit 'no attribute id' / 'next_close' errors because the IBKR adapter didn't expose an account id or full market-clock. Added both, plus order lookup/cancel for the DAY bracket bot. LONG now runs cleanly on its IBKR slice.

Also includes v4.6.52: saving the IBKR bot table no longer wipes your Cloud-24/7 login.

All IBKR bots verified on the cloud trading their own allocation slice. Update via the in-app banner.
